fixtures.orientations: 1..8 distributed; not full orientation x depth cross-product

wasm.scope: 109 alpha qualification cases (50 Gray/RGB depth/orientation fixtures, ordinary+EX, eight explicit unsupported-channel refusals, promoted-canvas admission) plus additional normalized9/10-bit promotion with source-code recovery, native Gray/GrayAlpha/RGB/RGBA8/12/16 and RGBA8 rounding, pixel limits, RGB/Gray embedded ICC and metadata limits, lossy djxl comparison, jxll levels5/10 with jxlc/jxlp and opaque jbrd, official jbrd still images (25 spatial pixel probes each, full ICC, dimensions, limits, ordinary Gray CMS refusal)

small_ICC_longer_followup.reason: Initial short-process measurements were bimodal/inconclusive, including an apparent25% gain; longer follow-up does not replace or hide those results

benchmark_method.build: cargo build -p wml2 --locked --release --no-default-features --features jpeg-xl,image-buffer-ex,color-management; distinct private CARGO_TARGET_DIR per tree, identical registry versions/checksums/root lock
benchmark_method.run: taskset -c 0 <probe> <input.jxl> ordinary|managed <iterations>; three alternating process pairs, three warmups per process; metadata creation timed, full pixel hashes outside timed interval
benchmark_method.interpretation: All output hashes match. Ordinary and large-managed medians differ-0.76%..+2.75%; small ICC/CMS is bimodal and inconclusive even with longer follow-up, with overlapping process ranges. No general speedup/no-regression/zero-overhead/RSS guarantee; large managed only3 timed calls per process.

limits.channels: at most one full-resolution straight alpha in accepted profile
limits.mixed_native: normalized Rgba16; independent source alpha depth metadata
limits.canvas: 8 bytes per pixel for mixed native working canvas admitted before decoder; 7x5 passes280/rejects279 bytes before callbacks
limits.other_caps: unchanged, including fixed caps with unlimited caller limits

remaining: associated alpha conversion requires separately qualified unassociation/zero-alpha/ICC-order contract
subsampled alpha fails the pinned direct core on independent fixture; runtime refuses before codec
float/other alpha depths, multiple/general extra planes explicitly refused
no HDR/tone mapping, animation, streaming, intrinsic/preview extension or production jxl upgrade
